notes:
I found three places that are open on Thursday to Sunday, November 12 to 15, 2026. All three come from each venue's own pages. None of them posts anything specific to those four dates, so each `when` is the venue's regular hours.

- **Children's Museum of Manhattan** is the best fit. 
It is on the Upper West Side and built for children ages 0-6.
 
Its hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 10 am–5 pm.
 
Its page notes that PlayWorks will be closed until 2 pm on Sunday, November 15.
 I found no current admission price on its pages, so none is listed.
- **Central Park Zoo** is open 
daily, 10:00 AM - 4:30 PM, from November 1, 2026 to March 25, 2027, with last entry 1 hour before closing.
 
All visitors must have a date-specific ticket.

- **Brooklyn Children's Museum** is 
open Wednesday–Sunday, 10 am–5 pm, and general admission is $15 per person.
 
Admission is free every Thursday from 2 pm–5 pm.
 That includes Thursday, November 12. Its own page gave me no age range, so I left the age fit out.
